source_issues.finding: Adam does not unconditionally solve all saddle/flat-region/oscillation problems. A plateau is not uniquely evidence of oscillation, and80%/20% coverage has no empirical setup. Retained faithfully; no convergence claim inferred from fixtures.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: Source recurrence omits(1-beta) multiplying gradient, so its state is an unnormalized exponentially weighted sum, not the mean of last10 gradients. Constant-gradient fixture yields6.513215599 at10steps rather than1.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: 10000 vs3000-5000 steps and3x faster lack a benchmark specification. No speedup or universal winner certified.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: First adaptive method that worked and never formally published are source historical claims; not independently researched for this translation review.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: Gradient magnitude does not reliably indicate closeness to an optimum or undertraining; epsilon protects zero denominator whenever it occurs, not solely a never-updated parameter. Original wording preserved.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: Source protected formula comment labels uncentered second moment variance; variance instead subtracts squared mean. Original comment and prose preserved; no equation repair.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: The near50step conclusion concerns beta1=.9 but does not hold for beta2=.999: factor1/(1-.999^50)>20 in finite arithmetic. Target preserves both source numbers and claim.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: Loss lambda*w^2 has derivative2*lambda*w; SGD additionally scales by lr. Source prose subtracting lambda*w omits convention/factors; not silently harmonized with later formula.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.category: AdamW sequential implementation differs from source equation
source_issues.finding: The code applies decay to the already Adam-updated parameter, introducing a cross term compared with the displayed single simultaneous update using oldw. Finite fixture atlr=.1,wd=.1 demonstrates .891000000495 vs .8900000005.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: Claims about virtually every task, PyTorch default, every named model, universal scheduling, and10x learning-rate importance are context-dependent source recommendations; not verified as current product or performance guidance.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: Example trains one sample at a time in fixed data order, reports pre-update online training predictions, and has no held-out set. These metrics do not demonstrate generalization or an optimizer-ranking benchmark. Empty data would divide by zero; finite fixture is eight examples,two epochs,not full default300.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: BCE probability clipping combined with out*(1-out) can give zero derivative at exact saturation; ordinary nonsaturated finite-difference tests pass but do not prove all numerical boundaries. Sigmoid500 exact1 was reproduced.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: Gradient clipping and scheduling are explicit separate calls around the optimizer. Inputs and labels in the example are fresh random tensors, so it illustrates order rather than meaningful learning. Torch block was pre-read but not run by this reviewer.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.category: Effective learning rate vs update amount
source_issues.finding: Expressionlr*m_hat/(sqrt(v_hat)+eps) includes moment direction and magnitude; it is parameter update magnitude/sign, not solely an effective learning-rate multiplier. Faithful source wording preserved.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: Delivered scratch Adam constructor has no weight_decay argument. Exercise does not specify adding coupledL2 for fair comparison; faster shrinkage is not guaranteed for every setup.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required

source_issues.finding: Minimal list-based classes omit parameter/gradient-length validation,state-resizing safeguards and beta/epsilon constraints. Finite ordinary cases pass; full tensor optimizer contract is not established.
source_issues.translation_action: Source preserved; no translation change required
